description:
Returns the groups to which a user belongs.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Browse users and groups* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The account ID of the user, which uniquely identifies the user across all Atlassian products. For example, *5b10ac8d82e05b22cc7d4ef5*.
parameters.name: accountId

parameters.description: This parameter is no longer available. See the [deprecation notice](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/deprecation-notice-user-privacy-api-migration-guide/) for details.
parameters.name: username

parameters.description: This parameter is no longer available. See the [deprecation notice](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/deprecation-notice-user-privacy-api-migration-guide/) for details.
parameters.name: key

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the calling user does not have the *Browse users and groups* global permission.

404.description: Returned if the user is not found.
